title: Casey & Miles
description: Miles came back from Los Angeles with two nights he still hasn't explained, and an answer for every question except that one.

questions.question: Sorry, I know this is a lot to drop on you. I just want to make sure this is actually his phone. You already know his first name is Miles, so can you give me his last name to confirm?
questions.hint: First time here? Close this sheet to get back to the phone. At the bottom of the screen, tap Phone — the green icon in the middle of the dock. Then open the Contacts tab (bottom right). The card at the very top of the list is his own, with his full name on it.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Settings. The name at the very top of the screen is the phone owner's own: Miles Draper.
Why: the account name in Settings belongs to the phone's owner, and his last name reads Draper.

questions.question: That's definitely his phone, but I don't have the courage to check the messages myself. What name is that suspicious contact saved under?
questions.hint: In the Messages app, see if any contact looks off — open that thread and see what makes you curious.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages and look for the chat whose contact name reads like a warning, not a person's name.
Why: the number is saved in the contacts under the name Do not pick up.

questions.question: I'm still in shock... We need to find out her name! Maybe they gave each other some kind of nickname.
questions.hint: Look through the conversation with that suspicious contact and see if he's given her some kind of nickname.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages → the chat with "Do not pick up". Miles ends his late-night texts with a pet name for her.
Why: he writes "Good night Mar" and "I promise, Mar", so the nickname is Mar.

questions.question: So we already have a clue... But I'm still curious about this girl with the nickname "Mar". Try to find out which app they met through.
questions.hint: Check the messages with Do not pick up for a mention of the dating app they met through.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages → the chat with Do not pick up, near the top of the thread.
Why: the reply reads "Bye Tinder — texting's so much better than that app", so they moved to texting after matching on Tinder.

questions.question: Wow... what a surprise, Miles Draper, you scumbag. I'm going to get to the bottom of this... He picked the place for their first date. What kind of food did he take her out for?
questions.hint: Read what Miles and her say about food, and what he tells her about the restaurant he booked.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages → the chat with Do not pick up. When she asks about the mystery restaurant for their first date, Miles calls it a small Italian spot.
Why: they both said they love Italian, and the place he booked for the first date is Italian.

questions.question: Italian... typical man. He took me to an Italian place on our first date too, but he's not stupid enough to take her somewhere we've already been. Could you help me find the name of that restaurant?
questions.hint: Check the Calendar app for the event on that day, then look up its address in the Maps app to find the restaurant's name.
questions.revealGuide:
Calendar → the event titled "Tinder Date", described as "First date": its location is a street address on Laurel Canyon Blvd.
Google Maps → the saved place at that same address: Pace 🍝.
Why: the first-date event's address matches the saved Maps place named Pace, so Pace is the restaurant.

questions.question: The night he stopped responding to me, he skipped his work Airbnb and booked another place just for that night. What's the name of that place?
questions.hint: His work Airbnb covers the whole trip. Look in his past stays for the extra booking that covers only that night.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Airbnb → Trips → Past. Two stays cover that night: the Los Angeles one is his work stay for the whole trip, and the extra one-night booking is Venice Loft.
Why: he told Gil he booked an Airbnb near her place, and she was staying in Venice.

questions.question: He slept with "Mar"?! Could you help me find out how much he paid to spend the night with her?
questions.hint: Check Wallet for a balance change that shows how much he paid.
questions.revealGuide:
Messages → the chat with Gil: he says he booked an Airbnb near her place for the night after.
Wallet → the RevoBank card ending 4321, the Airbnb charge at the top: -500.
Why: he booked the Airbnb to sleep with her, and that one charge on the RevoBank card is 500.

questions.question: That's a lot of money — and I just kept texting him like a fool. What excuse did he give me that night, so he could go sleep with her?
questions.hint: Read the messages exchanged with Casey that evening.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages → the chat with Casey 💖, near the bottom: he says he ran out of battery, then apologizes for the night before.
Why: the morning-after text says he left his charger at the office, so that was his excuse.

questions.question: There are hidden photos on here I'm not meant to see, I know there are. Can you get me the code for the hidden photos?
questions.hint: There is a clue to the code somewhere in Notes.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Notes → the note titled "Bits and pieces": its last line is labelled "iPhone photo code".
Why: the note lists the iPhone photo code as 243587, which unlocks the hidden photos.

questions.question: Now I have a face to the name, but I need to know exactly who she is. What is her last name?
questions.hint: Now that you know what she looks like, search Instagram for a profile whose name starts with Mar — that'll give you a clue to her real surname.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Instagram and search for a name starting with Mar.
Open the profile whose picture matches the woman from the previous clue: the display name shows her full name.
Why: the display name on that profile reads Marisa Kessler, so her last name is Kessler.

questions.question: I knew it. Please, could you tell me what year she was born?
questions.hint: Her Instagram username carries her birth year — just read it off her profile.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Instagram and search for Marisa Kessler's profile.
Read her username at the top: marisa___1997.
Why: the username carries her birth year, 1997.

questions.question: Right. Okay. Could you tell me where she lives? I want to know how far he was prepared to go.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Instagram → search for Marisa Kessler (marisa___1997) and read her profile bio.
Why: her bio gives her location as Las Vegas, Nevada.

questions.question: She lives that far away and he still chased her. Can you find out which company she works for?
questions.hint: Her bio doesn't say where she works. Check the comments on one of her posts for a coworker's comment that reveals it.
questions.revealGuide:
Instagram → Marisa Kessler's profile → the Las Vegas post with no caption: a comment calls her "Best coworker ever!"
Instagram → the profile of that commenter, Bex97: the bio names the company.
Why: Bex97 says Marisa is a coworker, and Bex97's bio reads "Community manager at Dior", so Marisa works for Dior.

questions.question: A scumbag will always justify his own actions. What excuse does he give?
questions.hint: Check the Messages app, in his thread with his best friend Gil.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages → the chat with Gil: after Gil asks about Casey: "and Casey in all this...?", the owner explains why things are complicated.
Messages → the chat with Gil, at the end: Gil asks what he'll tell Casey, and Miles says he wrote it all down in his notes.
Notes → the note titled "Draft": "I'm tired of the routine. Same evenings, same plans, same conversations."
Why: in his own words, he justifies the affair by being tired of the routine with Casey.

textSuccess: Thanks. I have it all now — her name, her age, every dollar he spent on her. Miles is going to feel this.

onboardingContent.text: Word is you're the best there is at stalking. So… here I am. I need you.
Miles and I have been together three years. Three years of laughing, travelling, building plans. We'd started talking about a wedding, a house, kids. It was supposed to be perfect.

Then he came back from that "business trip"  and everything shifted. 
He barely answered my messages while he was gone… and I haven't stopped doubting since. 
My gut says he's hiding something.
So yes… I did something insane: I'm handing you a copy of his phone. Messages, notes, apps — all of it is yours. I'll ask the questions while you dig. Over to you.

messages.text: Hey...
Someone gave me your name. Said you find what people try to hide.
Can I ask what to call you?
Thank you. I'm sorry, I don't know how to say this bit.
My boyfriend Miles just got back from a work trip in Los Angeles, and there are two nights he still can't explain... I'm sending you a photo of him.
He's asleep. I have his phone, but not for long.
{{name}}, please. There's nobody else I can ask.
